name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir rides on Ohgan's back for 30 s when he comes close and again 45 s later
contract: Round-9 tester (2026-11-15, Bronzebeard video of 2025-11-13, 28:07-28:40): when Ohgan (14988) gets
close, Mandokir (11382) mounts up, both stay active and attackable, and he dismounts about 30 s later.
Round-10 testers (2026-11-16): he must sit on Ohgan's back, not change to a mounted model while Ohgan
fights beside him. User decision 2026-11-16: within 10 yards of Ohgan (estimated) Mandokir enters
Ohgan as a vehicle passenger (vehicle 485, a stand-in seat) with Mounted 2118412, while Ohgan carries
Mounted 2118411 and fights his rider's target; after 30 s he dismounts, and mounts again 45 s later
when Ohgan is in reach, a 75 s cycle (charges 25 and 50 s apart in the live logs). Round 9 gave him
Ohgan's display 215271 as a mount of his own instead, so the passenger and no-display assertions
discriminate. Mandokir's timers wait while he casts, so a Whirlwind (3 s cast, 6 s spin) can hold the
dismount or the next mount back by up to 9 s; 25 s waits plus 16 s windows allow 41 s, and the 40 s
wait plus a 16 s window allow 56 s for the 45 s cooldown.
The tank is the only player, so every melee swing of Ohgan's the tank sees during the ride is at Mandokir's
target; at least 3 in 25 s shows he keeps fighting (threshold estimated, his attack speed is not asserted).
